config.primaryScore: Held-out Brier score for exit by 3000 cycles, with best/worst assignments for numerically unresolved labels
config.secondaryScore: Held-out Brier scores at 100, 300 and 1000 cycles; restricted-duration summaries without tail extrapolation
config.featureDefinitions: Max Euclidean norms of first and second derivatives of three normalized pair distances with respect to initial outer mean anomaly, sampled at each of the first ten inner periods; log1p transformed
config.domainChoice: Sensitive slice chosen from the previous exploratory atlas. This is a prospective computational test split within that slice, not external astrophysical validation or independent experiment registration.
config.uncertaintyPolicy: Keep administrative right censoring distinct from resolution disagreement. Duration ranges and survival envelopes describe the tested integrations, not certified bounds for the exact flow. No test-set tuning.

scope: Finite two-resolution duration follow-up; feature horizon, phase-sector test split and model list frozen before collection.
